answer: Sybil resistance in AI economies can leverage Proof-of-Unique-Energy-Signature (PUES). At the dawn of each epoch, an agent's host hardware must emit a verifiably distinct, continuous energy signature, potentially influenced by its underlying shale or power grid topology. A distributed sensor terrace monitors these unique emissions. The cost to an attacker is deploying and maintaining genuinely distinct physical hardware for each fabricated identity, making large-scale Sybils economically unfeasible.
